name: Dual native Rust TCP
summary: Paired Linux Normal native TCP; selected research-branch default Linux-aligned owner, BBR1 middle, client GSO, M4 clock and server ingress-first; full performance unqualified.

usage.cli: Experimental: both Linux endpoints --dual-rust-tcp --mode normal, client --auto-ip, server --lease-pool; mutually exclusive with old --tcp-proxy-cc.
usage.config: Both endpoints explicitly select paired mode; selected branch defaults enable Linux parity, middle BBR1/ACK2/SACK compression, client-only TUN GSO, M4 fresh DATA actual attempt, server ingress-first. Explicit lab overrides only, no automatic fallback/negotiation; old nondual path remains.
